description: Arup reports using the Pollination Revit-to-IESVE plug-in on more than 20 projects in the UK, Europe and Middle East. The case describes conversion of building geometry into analytical models, partial exports and use of a shared model for loads, energy, comfort and daylight analyses. Direct export to the VE .gem format and inspection of geometry during conversion address the reported modelling difficulties. The case reports a modelling workflow across a project portfolio; individual buildings and a common study period are not identified. This public HTML case narrative is published by IES and can be read without payment. Its reuse licence is not stated. Access to the described software, input data and project models is not established by the public page. The source does not give a complete study period or all spatial and temporal model resolutions. Reported results are provider claims and have not been independently reproduced. The case supports the documented infrastructure simulation use and is linked to the named modelling resources. Only metadata and the case description were inspected; no data or model files were downloaded.
